modules.title: Installing and Navigating
modules.content:
## How to Install the Team Logger

The Synergy Sports Softball Team Logger is available only to PC users. Install the application using the link provided. <https://www.synergysportstech.com/Apps/External/Logger/Production/>

Follow the instructions to complete the installation process.

1. Click **Install**
2. If asked, Click **Run**
3. After installing, the program will open and prompt you to log in.

### How to Log In

The login page provides several security improvements for the storage of user credentials. When logging in to the Synergy Team Baseball Logger for the first time, follow the instructions below:

1. Select your preferred language

2. Click the **Remember Me** box in the app to store credentials for future use

3. Select the **Click here to log in** button in the app to launch the web browser

![Screenshot: How to Install the Team Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565473-01.jpg)4. Enter your username & password in the web browser

5. Select the **Login** button in the web browser to automatically return back to the app

6. For future use, the app will automatically login if "Remember me" is selected

![Screenshot: How to Install the Team Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565473-02.jpg)

## Navigating The Homescreen

Welcome to the Synergy Logger. In this article, we will explore the features of the **Games** view, which is the application’s default view. From here, you can add, edit, or delete games that you would like to log. Additional views include **Transfer, Log,** **Import**, and **Sync**, which we will explore in subsequent articles.

Any view can be easily accessed by selecting it from the top of the page.

![Screenshot: Navigating The Homescreen](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565476-01.jpg)

The hamburger menu to the left of the views contains a variety of options including Settings. To access, click the menu and then **Settings** to open the general settings window.  Access and change information such as your application data directory, video cache folder, log files, video playback options, and how to display pitch velocity (MPH or KPH).

![Screenshot: Navigating The Homescreen](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565476-02.jpg)

In the Settings window, click the **Import** tab to locate and customize information such as video encoding quality, the location of the folder where you save video encoding imports, how many simultaneous video encodes, video uploads, data uploads, video downloads you want to allow, and how to customize imported files that get uploaded to the Synergy Cloud.

![Screenshot: Navigating The Homescreen](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565476-03.jpg)

Located on the upper-left side of the screen are the **Game**and **Management** tabs.

Select the **Games** tab to view a detailed list of all games that you have logged or are in the process of logging. View information such as Game Date, Away Team, Home Team, if the game had a DH, the final score, type of game (e.g. regular season, playoffs, fall ball, etc.), if video has been uploaded, downloaded (making it available for offline use), or published to the Synergy cloud.

![Screenshot: Navigating The Homescreen](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565476-04.jpg)

The **Management** tab allows you to manage your roster. Use this tab to add teams or players to the logger.

![Screenshot: Navigating The Homescreen](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565476-05.jpg)

Located on the upper-left side of the screen are the **Game**and **Management** tabs.

Under the tab list are the filtering options for the Game tab. These are only viewable from this tab, and they help you sort different information through customized filtering selections. These selections are Type of Team, League, Season, Team, Opponent, and Game type. The filters are dynamic and will update the data as you apply your selections. If you’d like to reset the chosen filters, click the **Reset All** button to the left.

![Screenshot: Navigating The Homescreen](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565476-06.jpg)

modules.title: Teams and Players
modules.content:
## Creating Teams and Players

To get started, click on the **Management**tab in the upper left of the home screen.  Use this tab to create both player lists and teams.

Create, edit or delete existing teams from the **Teams**tab. To create a team, click the **Add Team**button in the upper right and continue by completing the fields shown below and click **Apply**when finished:

- Team
- Abbreviation
- League
- Conference
- Division

![Screenshot: Creating Teams and Players](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565477-01.jpg)

![Screenshot: Creating Teams and Players](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565477-02.jpg)

Creating a player is very similar to creating a team. From the **Management**window, select the **Players**tab.

Click on the **Players Tab**in the center of the screen to view the screen where you can create, edit or delete players.

Once clicked, the below screen will appear.

![Screenshot: Creating Teams and Players](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565477-03.jpg)

Create, edit or delete existing players from the Players tab. To create a team, click the Add Player button in the upper right and continue by completing the fields shown below and click Apply when finished:

- First Name
- Last Name
- League
- Height
- Weight
- Bats
- Throws
- Birth Date
- Hometown

Once players are created they will appear in the players list and are sortable based on the filter options available.  The filter options include League, Conference, Division, Team, and by Date.

Players are also searchable by typing in a player name into the Player Search text box in the upper right.

To add a player, click on the **Add Player**button.  Once clicked, the below screen will appear.

![Screenshot: Creating Teams and Players](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565477-04.jpg)

Use the Edit Player or Delete Player buttons in the upper right to make changes to player's information or remove them from the roster. If a player is deleted all the associated with that player will be deleted as well.

## Player Management: Merge Players

Under the Management tab, you now have the ability to Merge Players. If you have created duplicate players in order to use players in practice on both home and away teams, you can now merge these players into one profile for more accurate reporting. The ability to use the same player profile on both teams of a practice eliminates the need for creating duplicate players, and with the use of the Merge Players tool, you can now have any previous data rolled into a single player profile.

#### Getting Started

To start the process of merging players, select the **Management** tab. Click the **Show My Players** button, or use the Player Search bar to find your created players. Select your duplicate player, then click **Merge Player** in the top right of the app.

![Screenshot: Player Management: Merge Players](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565479-01.jpg)

With the duplicate player in the search field on the left, and you will merge them with the primary player in the right search field. Verify the information listed is the player in question, name, birthdate, height, weight, batting hand, throwing hand, and Player ID, which will be a My Team number. Once you have done that, then search for the primary player in the search field on the right. Verify the information listed is the correct player, their Synergy ID.

![Screenshot: Player Management: Merge Players](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565479-02.jpg)

Now you have the ability to merge all listed events to one Player ID. You can also merge events from a single game or practice, if for example, early in you season, a player participated in a game, but was not previously entered into your roster and their events where recorded under a different players profile.

If you accidentally select the player profile of the wrong side of the merge, you can click the swap button between the search fields, and the player of the right will swap with the player on the left. It is important to note, that the event data always moves from the player on the left to the player on the right.

Once the event merge has been completed, you can return to the Management tab and delete the duplicate created player.

modules.title: Managing Games
modules.content:
## Add, Edit or Delete a Game

To get started, click on the **Add Game** icon located to the right below the View menu.

![Screenshot: Add, Edit or Delete a Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565481-01.jpg)

Starting on the left in the Add Game window, input the following information:

- **League**: E.g. Major League Baseball, College, Cape Cod Baseball League, Minor League Baseball, etc.
- **Date**: the date that the game was played
- **Start Time****:** the time that the game began
- **Time Zone**: the time zone of the game that was played
- **Game Type**: depending on the league, game type is chosen from the preset game types (E.g. Regionals, World Series, Division Series, Super Regionals, etc.)
- **Away Team**: the name of the visiting team
- **Home Team**: the name of the home team
- **Doubleheader**: select if the game is part of a doubleheader and whether it is the first or second game

![Screenshot: Add, Edit or Delete a Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565481-02.jpg)

In the center of the screen, is the **Lineup** section. Use this area to adjust your lineup as needed. To make adjustments, enter the lineup data into the Logger by utilizing the Player Search to the right of Lineup. Search for the player from a roster that you've already inputted, and either add or remove them from the lineup by using the **Add to Lineup** or **Remove from Lineup** buttons.

The **Send to Offline** button under the roster allows you to send this section offline so that you can work on it without a wifi connection.

![Screenshot: Add, Edit or Delete a Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565481-03.jpg)

In order to delete a game, select the game on the main screen and choose the **Delete Game** button in the upper right. If you select this option, you will not be able to recover the information that you added previously.

## Games View

The **Games**view is the default location when logging into the application.  From this view:

- Explore game information including dates, teams, score, and game type
- Add, edit or delete games
- Edit game, players, and lineup information
- Check logging status
- Check upload totals and status
- Check offline availability
- See whether a game is logged or published

![Screenshot: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565487-01.jpg)

Access tools to help you log your games from the **Games** view. Use the **Add Game** button to create a new game or select **Edit Game** or **Delete Game** to make changes or remove a game from your list.

![Screenshot: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565487-02.jpg)

The Games view filters are located below the Games | Management tabs. All of the filters in the application are dynamic and will populate the selected data as selections are made. Choose to filter:

- Type of Team
- League
- Season
- Team
- Opponent
- Game Type

![Screenshot: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565487-03.jpg)

The data tables created once your initial filters are set to include:

- **Game Date** shows the date the game was played
- **Away Team** lists the visiting team
- **Home Team** lists the team hosting the game
- **Designated Hitter** indicates whether a designated hitter was used
- **Final Score** shows the score when the game ended
- **Game Type** lists whether it was a regular season game, playoffs, tournament, etc.
- **Logging Status** shows what stage of logging the game is in
- **Video** shows if there is a video it will indicate the number of angles present
- **Offline** indicates if the video has been downloaded to the local machine or is available in the Synergy Cloud
- **Published** indicates if a game has been uploaded to the Synergy Cloud
- Use the radio button on the left-hand side of the screen to select or deselect a game you'd like to view.

![Screenshot: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565487-04.jpg)

## Linked Games

#### **Linked Games enable you to:**

- Automatically attach your logged game video and pitch chart data to the correct Synergy game.
- Eliminate the need to upload the same video files and pitch chart data separately in Video Express.
- Use Synergy Team Logger as your primary application for logging games, uploading video, and pitch chart data.

#### **Video Permissions for Linked Games**

Rest assured, your team's privacy is a top priority.

- All private camera angles from your Team Logger videos for Synergy logged games will remain visible *only* to your team and will not be accessible by other schools.
- As with Video Express, Colleges can view the following public camera anglesfrom other teams for Linked Games:
  - As Logged (Best available camera angle used for Synergy logging)
  - Broadcast
  - CF
  - High Home
  - Low Home
- All other camera angles will remain private to your team.

####

#### **Key Recommendations for Using Linked Games**

To ensure smooth experience and accurate data tagging, please follow these recommendations:

- **Link while creating your game:** It's best practice to link to Synergy during the initial game creation process.
- **Wait for video upload:** Crucially, wait until *all* video files from each Camera Angle are uploaded to Synergy **before** changing the Logging Status to "Completed." This ensures all data, including Fielding & Baserunning, can be tagged correctly.
- **Neutral Site Games:** For neutral site games where Home/Away teams are swapped, you can still link to Synergy if the game date and teams are the same. Synergy will update once official box scores are available.
- **Doubleheader Games:** If only one game of a doubleheader displays for linking, you can link to a Synergy game on a different date involving the same teams if Synergy hasn't updated the schedule yet.
- **One-to-One Linking:** It's only possible to link to one Synergy game at a time.
- **Uncertainty:** If you're unsure about linking, contact Synergy Support and proceed with uploading video and pitch charts in Video Express as an alternative.

#### **Workflows: Adding and Linking a Game**

#####

##### **Adding a New Game**

When you navigate to the Games view, you'll now see a "Linked" column with a colorized Synergy logo for games already linked to Synergy.

![Screenshot: Linked Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591933-01.jpg)

To add and link a game:

1. Click **"Add Game"**.
2. Input your game information as usual.
3. A new **"Link to Synergy"** section will appear above "Create from File."
4. Click the **"Search for Matching Game"** button within this section.

![Screenshot: Linked Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591933-02.jpg)

##### **Searching for a Matching Synergy Game**

After clicking "Search for Matching Game":

1. A pop-up list will display potential corresponding Synergy games.
2. By default, a Synergy game will be pre-selected if the game date and teams are the same.
3. The list will show all games involving the Home and Away teams for the entire season.
4. If your game isn't displaying, you can change the top filters to search for different Synergy games.
5. Select the correct Synergy game from the list.
6. Click **"Apply"**.
7. The linked Synergy game will now be displayed, with an option to **"Unlink"** if needed.
8. You can now continue with your normal process of adding lineups and creating the game.

#####

![Screenshot: Linked Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591933-03.png)

![Screenshot: Linked Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591933-04.jpg)

##### **Import View Changes**

When adding video files on the **Import view**:

- You will now see either **"Home"** or **"Away"** displayed for each Camera Angle, indicating whether your account's team is the Home or Away team. This helps Synergy confirm the video files are linked from Synergy Team Logger.
- For neutral site games where Home & Away teams are swapped, Synergy will adjust the designation once official box scores are received.
- **Important:** Please wait until *all* video files from each Camera Angle are uploaded to Synergy **before** changing the Logging Status to **"Completed."** This action informs Synergy that your game is fully ready for logging.

![Screenshot: Linked Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591933-05.jpg)

![Screenshot: Linked Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591933-06.jpg)

modules.title: Video and Network Cameras
modules.content:
## Importing Your Video

The Synergy Softball Team Logger includes a file delivery system that allows Synergy to receive multiple angles of game film that helps tie logged data to video so that it can be used to create detailed clips. These clips are utilized for scouting as well as for other Synergy products such as the Synergy Softball Application and Synergy Editor.

To begin, click on the **Import** button in the View menu located in the upper right of the application.

Once clicked, the below screen will appear.

![Screenshot: Importing Your Video](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565484-01.jpg)

In the video panel, choose how many angles you wish to include and select the files you wish to import to the Softball Team Logger. Choose to upload all your video to the Synergy cloud using the associated radio button to the right. By not selecting this option, the video you import will only be available on the computer it was imported on. choose the following options to determine the type of video that you import to the Synergy Softball Logger.

To add the video file for each of the camera angles that you have selected. Click on the **Add Video File(s)** button and browse to locate the video from your computer that you'd like to import.  Once the video has been located, press Open to choose it for the angle that you have designated.  This process is the same for each of the camera angles you have selected.

![Screenshot: Importing Your Video](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565484-02.jpg)

Once each camera angle has a video associated with it, click the **Start** button to begin the import process. **Pause** or **cancel** the process by clicking the associated buttons.  If you'd like to delete the imported video configuration that has been set up, click the **Delete** button.

## Setting Up and Using Network Cameras

### Requirements

Your network camera setup information will be stored **locally on your device**. Ensure that the setup is performed on the same device you intend to use for recording games or practices.

Your device must be connected to the **same network** as your IP cameras using an **Ethernet cable**. Wi-Fi is **not recommended**, as it may result in dropped connections, skipped frames, or other recording issues.

### Configuring Network Cameras

Open the application settingsby clicking the **Three Line** dropdown menu and selecting **Settings**.

![Screenshot: Setting Up and Using Network Cameras](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000582122-01.jpg)

Navigate to the **Network** tab, the third tab on the right.

Click the **Add Camera** icon to add a new camera. For each camera:

- **Name** the camera.
- Select the appropriate **camera angle** from the dropdown menu.
- Enter the **RTSP stream link (Network Camera Path)** in the designated field.

![Screenshot: Setting Up and Using Network Cameras](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000582122-02.jpg)

Repeat these steps for each IP camera you plan to use. Once all camera information has been entered, click **Apply** to save your configuration.

### Common Network Paths:

Axis network camera path: *username*:*password*@*cameraipaddress*/axis-media/media.amp

Bosch network camera path: *username*:*password*@*cameraipaddress*:*portnumber*(Default port number is 554)

### Start Recording with Network Cameras

In the Games or Practice view, select the game or practice session you intend to record. Once selected, navigate to the **Import** page.

![Screenshot: Setting Up and Using Network Cameras](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000582122-03.jpg)

Under the **Total Camera Angles** dropdown, select the number of camera angles you plan to use.

For each angle:

- Use the dropdown menu to assign the corresponding camera angle.
- Click the **Start Network Camera** button next to the selected angle to begin recording.

![Screenshot: Setting Up and Using Network Cameras](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000582122-04.jpg)

A red dot will appear next to each angle to indicate that recording is active. You can verify ongoing recording by:

- Ensuring the red dot remains visible.
- Confirming that the file size continues to increase.
- Clicking the **Play** icon next to each angle to preview the live video feed.

![Screenshot: Setting Up and Using Network Cameras](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000582122-05.jpg)

### Log the Game

Now that the cameras are recording, you can proceed to the **Log** page. You can now log the game as you normally would using one of two methods:

- Select the **No Video** checkbox to log plays while watching live on the field.
- Deselect the **No Video** checkbox and click the **Capture** button. A video player will appear, allowing you to log directly from the live recording.

![Screenshot: Setting Up and Using Network Cameras](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000582122-06.jpg)

### Stop Recording

Return to the **Import** page after logging is complete. Click the **Stop Network Camera** button next to each active angle. Confirm that the red recording indicator (red dot) disappears, indicating that the recording has stopped.

![Screenshot: Setting Up and Using Network Cameras](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000582122-07.jpg)

### Sync Video and Events

Now that your game is logged and your recording has been stopped, you can navigate to the **Sync** page to synchronize your recorded camera angles.

If the game was logged using the **No Video** option, you will also need to manually sync your logged events to the video. Once all video angles have been synced, as well as events, click **Apply**. For detailed guidance, refer to our support article on Sync View (see the “Transferring, Syncing and Sharing” lesson in Synergy Team Logger for Baseball).

![Screenshot: Setting Up and Using Network Cameras](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000582122-08.jpg)

### Encode and Upload Video

After syncing, you must return to the **Import** page. Click the **Start** button at the top of the camera angles list to begin **encoding and uploading** your video files.

![Screenshot: Setting Up and Using Network Cameras](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000582122-09.jpg)

You can monitor the progress next to each angle:

- Encoding and upload status will display in real time.
- A **checkmark** will appear in the **Upload** box for each angle once processing is complete.

modules.title: Logging Your Game
modules.content:
## **How to Log a Game**

To get started, select the **Games**view in the menu bar in the upper right.  Choose the game you'd like to log by clicking the corresponding radio button to the left in the games list.

If you do not see the game you'd like to log in to the list and apply or reset the filters using the**Reset All** button above the list It is also possible that the game may not have been created yet.

Continue by selecting the **Log** button located in the menu bar to the upper right of the **Log** window. At the top of the screen, is the box score that indicates the date of the game, which teams are playing, the innings, runs scored in each inning, and the cumulative runs, hits, and errors during the game.  Next to the box score are the **Capture Video,** **Logger,** and **Play-by-Play** buttons.  These will be covered later in this article.

![Screenshot: Logging Your Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565489-01.jpg)

## **Pitcher Information**

Below the box score is the pitcher information and batter information.  On the left side of the screen, the pitcher information lists the pitcher, pitch count, catcher, and if the pitcher throws with their left or right hand.

To log a pitching change, click on the pitcher's name and select the new pitcher from the roster pop-up. Click **Done** to apply the changes.

![Screenshot: Logging Your Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565489-02.jpg)

## **Batter Information**

To the right of the pitcher and catcher information, is the batter information.  It displays the previous batter, the current batter's name, on deck hitter, and the number for each.

If a lineup change occurs, you can choose a new batter using a similar process to pitchers and catchers, this time selecting through the available batters.

![Screenshot: Logging Your Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565489-03.jpg)

Scroll through the lineup to choose which hitter's at-bat to log by using the up and down arrows next to the batter's information.  Additionally, use the **L** and **R** buttons to designate whether the batter hits left or right-handed for this at-bat.

## **Choosing Pitch Types, Speed, Location, and Results**

The Baseball Team Logger allows you to track many additional types of pitching information.  These options include pitch types, speed, location, and pitch results.  Begin by choosing a pitch type, located from the left side of the screen.

All pitch types are associated with a hotkey that allows you to easily log a pitch type by using shortcuts on your keyboard. Hotkeys are conveniently listed next to the respective pitch.

To designate the location of the pitch, use your mouse or trackpad to easily log the pitch location within the pitch location graphic and designate the pitch result or non-ball in-play result.

Use the pitch speed scroll bar below the graphic to log the pitch speed.  This scroll bar can be changed using the up and down arrows.

If you'd like to change the view type do so by clicking on the **Pitcher v**iew or **Catcher**view buttons below the pitch speed scroll bar.

At any time if you'd like to clear this information do so by clicking on the **Clear** button next to the views.

![Screenshot: Logging Your Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565489-04.jpg)

Pitch types include (hotkey listed in parentheses):

- Fastball (1)
- Curveball (2)
- Slider (3)
- Changeup (4)
- Cutter (5)
- Splitter (6)
- Knuckleball (7)
- Sinker (8)
- Four-seam Fastball (9)
- Two-Seam Fastball (0)
- Screwball (A)
- Forkball (R)
- Knuckle Curve (L)
- Eephus (E)

Additionally, there are pitch types listed below the scroll list for other types of pitching events.  These include:

- Unknown (U)
- Intentional Ball (V)
- Pitchout (P)

After a pitch type has been selected, choose a pitch location.

Under pitch result, log whether each pitch was

- (B) for a ball
- (T) for a called strike
- (S) for a swinging strike
- (F) for a foul ball
- (D) for in play

If a pitch did not result as a ball in play, log it using the following "Non-BIP Result"

- (K) strikeout
- (W) walk
- (N) intentional walk
- (H) Hit by pitch
- (C) catcher's interference
- (Y) Hitter's interference
- (Z) using the drop-down choose the runner who struck out and reached base by either wild pitch or passed ball

![Screenshot: Logging Your Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565489-05.jpg)

## **Selecting Swing or Bunt Types**

Below the Pitch Result and non-BIP result section is select Swing Type and select Bunt Type. In order to choose the swing type or bunt type, click on the respective drop-down and select from the list.

Swing Types:

- Full Swing
- Excuse Me Swing
- Slap Swing
- Fake Bunt Swing
- Runner Protection
- Standard Bunt Swing

![Screenshot: Logging Your Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565489-06.jpg)

Bunt Types:

- Bunt Sacrifice
- Bunt Hit
- Bunt Suicide Squeeze
- Bunt Safety Squeeze
- Bunt Drag
- Bunt Push

![Screenshot: Logging Your Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565489-07.jpg)

Use the radio buttons next to the swing and bunt type to designate whether a swing was a check swing or resulted in a broken bat.

## **How to Log Ball in Play Events**

Next to the hitter's information in the upper right is the Ball in Play Graphic.  Click on this graphic to bring up the ball in play logger.  Determine the following for each ball in play. Every event that can be logged is defined, with the associated hotkeys, as listed below.  If you would like to show or hide the field zone in the window, click on **Show Field Zone** or **Hide Field Zone** respectively.

![Screenshot: Logging Your Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565489-08.jpg)

Ball in play type:

- (Z) ground ball
- (X) line drive
- (C) fly ball
- (V) pop up
- (B) flare

BIP Result

- (Q) out Using the drop-down this can be labeled as Infield Fly Rule or a regular Out
- (W) single
- (E) double Using the drop-down this can be labeled as a Ground Rule Double or regular Double
- (R) Triple
- (T) Home Run Using the drop-down this can be labeled as an Inside the Park Home Run or a regular Home Run
- (Y) Error
- (U) Fielder's Choice Out
- (P) Fielder's Choice
- (H Sacrifice Bunt
- (J) Sacrifice Fly
- (K) Double Play
- (L) Triple Play

Hit Quality

- (S) Hard
- (D) Medium
- (F) Soft
- (G) Very Soft

Field Zones

- (Z + 1) Infield Left FL
- (Z + L) Infield Left
- (Z + C) Infield Center
- (Z + R) Infield Right
- (Z + 2) Infield Right FL
- (Z + 3) Outfield Left FL
- (Z + 4) Outfield Left
- (Z + 5) Outfield Left Center
- (Z + 6) Outfield Center
- (Z + 7) Outfield Right Center
- (Z + 8) Outfield Right
- (Z + 9) Outfield Right FL
- (Z + H) Home Plate
- (F + 1) Foul Infield Left
- (F + 2) Foul Infield Right
- (F + 3) Foul Outfield Left
- (F + 4) Foul Outfield Right
- (H + 1) HR Left Fl
- (H + 2) HR Left
- (H + 3) HR Left Center
- (H + 4) HR Center
- (H + 5) HR Right Center
- (H + 6) HR Right
- (H + 7) HR Right Fl

Errors

- (^E+F) FIeld

Interference

- (^EI+F) Fielder
- (^I+N) Fan Interference

On the right is the positional grid that lets you quickly identify and log who is at bat using their position number as a shortcut.  To log a player's ball in play click on the associated number of their position to add them to the list. These players will appear in the list shown below the positional grid.

Above the player position numbers is the counting grid.  Click on any of the **Balls**, **Strikes,** or **Outs** to change the associated number.

Once the ball-in-play information has been logged, click on **Apply** to save.

## **How to Log Baserunning Events**

Next to the Ball-in-Play window is the Baserunning view that lets you log base running events.  Click to start logging baserunning events.

![Screenshot: Logging Your Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565489-09.jpg)

Once you've logged players into the game, their information will appear on the left side of the screen.  To begin logging base running events, click on the corresponding base they advanced to where you will see the information below.

Use the **+** or **-** button to add a player or remove a player from a base.  When clicked, choose the player from the roster.  An arrow that points forward or back can designate where the baserunner moves in the next event.

On the right side of the screen are the RBI, corresponding totals, and balls, strikes, and outs markers. Click on these to designate if a player's at-bat ended in an RBI, how many, and to designate what the count is.

Underneath the RBI and count is the Advance and Out Result events that are available to log.  Each comes with its own corresponding hotkey listed below in parentheses.

Advance (Non-BIP)

- (W) Stolen Base
- (E) SB Error
- (R) Pickoff SB
- (T) Pickoff Error
- (Y) Defensive Indifference
- (U) Advance on the throw
- (B) Error
- (P) Passed Ball
- (A) Wild Pitch
- (S) Balk
- (D) Defensive Interference

Out Result

- (3) Caught Stealing
- (4) Pickoff
- (5) Picked Off Stealing
- (6) Runner Out
- (9) Stretch Out
- (7) Doubled Off
- (1) Runner Interference
- (8) Other

Use the Runner Going and Delayed Steal radio buttons below the Advance (Non-BIP) and Out Result lists to designate the respective events.

At the bottom of the screen, quickly go to the next or previous at-bats by clicking **Prev At Bat** or **Next At Bat**.

Once all events have been logged, click **Apply** to save.

## **Using Play by Play**

Located in the upper right is the Play by Play View.  This view presents all logged information in by inning, hit type, and hit result.

From here, you can edit all information after it has been entered by using the editing tools available.

Starting on the left where players' names are visible and grouped by the sequence of events that occur in each inning, use the **+** button to go back to the logging screen or use the **X** button to remove this event associated with this player.

Resort this view to show in a complete list instead of by inning. Clicking on the **List** button above the player name to sort. Click the **Inning** button to revert the view back.

On the right, use the + button to add a new event to the hit type and hit result list, click the button that resembles a pencil to return to the **Logger** view to edit the event type. Use the **X** icon to remove the specific event from the list. Click the **Play** button to play the video associated with the event.

Click **Add Last** to add a blank event at the end of the list.

Click the arrow next to PDF to begin the process of downloading the list view into a PDF.  This PDF can be used to upload the pitch chart into Synergy Video Express.

![Screenshot: Logging Your Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565489-10.jpg)

##

## **Settings**

To access the Team Logger settings, click on the **Settings** button above the count and pitch type list.

When configuring your settings, press **Update** to save them.

![Screenshot: Logging Your Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565489-11.jpg)

modules.title: Practice: Sim Game
modules.content:
The Sim Game practice session is a flexible tagging workflow, that allows you the ability to log a team scrimmage, or live BP. This flexibility allows you to set up one team with hitters, and one team with pitchers, without the need to set up fielders for either team.

### Getting Started

To create a new Sim Game session, select the **Practice** tab. In the top right of the window, click the black triangle next to **Add Practice**, and select **Sim Game** from the drop down menu.

![Screenshot: Practice: Sim Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565496-01.jpg)

Next, set your League, Date, Away Team, and Home Team. You can apply the same team as both the home and away team, eliminating the need to create a custom team or roster. You can still mark the game as a double header, as well as create a game from file for TrackMan users.

![Screenshot: Practice: Sim Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565496-02.jpg)

One of the biggest advantages to the new Sim Game practice session is the ability to have the same player to appear on both the home and away teams simultaneously. Set your team lineups by selecting from the roster on the right. If the player you're looking for isn't listed, use the Player Search bar to find the player, and add them to the player list.

![Screenshot: Practice: Sim Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565496-03.jpg).
![Screenshot: Practice: Sim Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565496-04.jpg)

You also have the ability to set a Player, Coach, or Machine as the pitcher for the session. By simply double clicking **Coach** or **Machine**, they will be automatically assigned as the pitcher for that game, as pitcher is the only position allowed for Coach or Machine. Once all of your Lineups are set, click **Apply** to create the Sim Game session. Once your Sim Game session has been created, select it from the list of practices, and select **Log**.

![Screenshot: Practice: Sim Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565496-05.jpg)

You now have the ability to set up situational hitting. By selecting the Runners screen on the right, you can select a base, then click the **+** button next to the base, and add a Ghost Runner. This can be applied to multiple bases allowing you to set up whichever situation you desire. This allows you ability to filter after the fact to see how your players performed in any particular situation you practiced.

![Screenshot: Practice: Sim Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565496-06.jpg)
![Screenshot: Practice: Sim Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565496-07.jpg)

Additionally, if your practice involves hitters facing a set amount of pitches, and your hitter gets on base, you can use the arrows next to the hitter section to regress back to them in the hitting lineup, without losing their advancement on the bases. On the Runners screen, the hitter will be represented multiple times, or you can change them to a Ghost Runner if you desire, but the hitting and pitching data will still be recorded for the selected players.

![Screenshot: Practice: Sim Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565496-08.jpg)

![Screenshot: Practice: Sim Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565496-09.jpg)

We have also added the ability to allow more than three outs per inning in a Sim Game practice session. If your pitcher is throwing a set amount of pitches, they may face more than three outs and this workflow will accommodate that. When you select the **Apply** button after the third out of the inning, a prompt will appear allowing you to either advance to the next inning, or decline and remain in the same inning. You will be prompted after each out after three outs have been recorded, until you advance to the next inning.

![Screenshot: Practice: Sim Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565496-10.jpg)

Once you select **Yes** to advance to the next inning/pitcher, the logger will advance the game to the bottom of the inning. Assuming the away team are your pitchers and will not be hitting, you can advance to the top of the next inning by selecting the inning desired at the top of the screen. This will bring your hitters team lineup back up, and you can change the pitcher before resuming your practice session.

![Screenshot: Practice: Sim Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565496-11.jpg)

modules.title: Practice: Batting Practice
modules.content:
The Batting Practice workflow allows you to create Hitter Groups, quickly create clips for each pitch, and easily switch between players. Batting practice also allows for flexible data tagging, where no data tags are required, besides a single click clip creation for each pitch.

### Getting Started

To create a new batting practice session, select the **Practice** tab. In the upper right corner, click **Add Practice**, then select **Batting Practice** from the drop-down menu.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-01.jpg)

Begin by selecting the **League**, **Date**, and **Team** for your Batting Practice in the far left panel. In the lineup panel, you can add as many groups for hitters as you want by clicking the **+** button next to Group 1. If you would like to remove a group, simply click the **X** next to the group you would like to remove.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-02.jpg)

Select the group you would like to add hitters to, then in the player panel on the right, double click on the player name to add them to the selected group. You can also assign either a player, coach, or machine as the pitcher for the practice session. To designate coach or machine as the pitcher, simply double click on Coach at the bottom of the player list.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-03.jpg)

Once you have added all of your hitters you can verify each group is correct by selecting the associated group tab. If you would like to move a player up or down in the order within a group, select the desired player, then, using the up and down arrow buttons to the right of the player lineup you can move the player to the desired order.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-04.jpg)

To remove a player, select the player you would like to remove, then click the **Remove from Lineup** button above the Group. When all of your groups are set as you would like, click **Apply** to create the session.

### Importing Video

Under the Practice tab, you will now see a new practice session created that displays the **Date**, **Team**, number of **Players**, and **Batting Practice** under the **Practice Type**. Select the newly created session, and click the **Import** button at the top right of the app to add the video file(s) associated with your batting practice session.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-05.jpg)

Begin by selecting the number of angles you wish to import from the Total Camera Angles dropdown. For each camera, assign the angle from the dropdown menu. Then, click the **Add Video File(s)** button, and select all video files from that angle associated with the batting practice session.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-06.jpg)

Click the **Start** button to upload your video files. Once successfully uploaded, a green checkmark will display in the Upload column.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-07.jpg)

###

### Synching Video

Now that your video files have been uploaded, if you are using more than one angle, you can sync them by clicking the **Sync** button at the top right of the app. Using the scrubbing tools below the video player, find a very specific point in the first pitch, that is visible from both angles, for example, the moment of impact. Repeat this step with all additional camera angles, then click the **Create New Sync Point** button to the right of the video players, and click **Apply** at the bottom of the window. For a more in depth look at the synch process, click here (see the “Transferring, Syncing and Sharing” lesson).

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-08.jpg)

## Logging

Now that your angles are synched, you can begin your logging. Click the **Log** button at the top right of the app. The batting practice logging screen will display as shown below.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-09.jpg)

The default display is set to the hit location screen, however if you want to add pitch location, the view can be easily switched by clicking the strike zone chart in the upper right.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-10.jpg)

On the left you will see the groups you created with the associated players listed within, allowing you to easily toggle between groups, and quickly select the next player with a single click.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-11.jpg)

Under Pitch Type you will see listed all the different pitch types which can be selected, including their associated hotkeys for quick data entry.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-12.jpg)

In the table to the right of the hit location screen, Swing Result, BIP Type and Hit Quality tags are listed, along with their hotkeys for quick data entry. There are also dropdown menus to Select Swing Type, and Select Bunt Type.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-13.jpg)

To begin logging, open up the capture window by clicking the **Capture** button in the top right. The number within the camera icon reflects the number of camera angle uploaded into the logger.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-14.jpg)

Now that the capture window is open, your video will display, and you can advance the video to the first recorded pitch to begin marking the swings. The goal of this stage of the process is to simply marking events within your video timeline. Select your at-bat player, then, with the video running, click the green **Mark Swing/Take** button each time the player swings. This will create an event for each swing, displayed in the table in the bottom right of the Logger screen. Once the hitter has taken their pitches, select the next player at-bat, and continue the process.

> NOTE: Marking Swing/Take is a one-click action. The event will create a six second clip, beginning four seconds before the click, and ending two seconds after. This eliminates the need to create start and stop points.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-15.jpg)

If you hit the **Mark Swing/Take** by accident, or the batter doesn't swing, you can click the **Remove Swing/Take** button next to it to remove the event, and continue on to the next pitch.

### Adding Batting Data

Once your batting practice session is complete, you can then go back and add any information you would like to each swing event. Select **Play By Play** view in the top right of the window, and each group and their players will be listed on the left. You can expand or collapse each group by clicking the triangle next to it's name. Select a player, and their batting events will be displayed on the right. By clicking the pencil icon, you can edit each event to add your information.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-16.jpg)

Your video will display in separate window, where you can switch between angles, and now you can enter your Pitch Type, Hit Location, Swing Result, BIP Type, and Hit Quality. You can also enter your pitch location if desired by clicking the **Strike Zone** icon in the top right next to the hitter's name. Once you have entered all the information you desire, click **Apply** at the bottom to save your data. When you return to the Play By Play View, all of that data will now be displayed, and associated with that video clip.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-17.jpg)

If substitutions are needed to be made after the fact, for example the wrong player was created for the session, all changes should be made in **Play By Play** view. In the same manner, select the player in question, and click the **Edit** button for the event.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-18.jpg)

Now you can select the hitter name above the hit location chart, select the correct hitter from the list of Hitter Substitutions, click **Done**, and then A**pply** at the bottom of the screen.

![Screenshot: Practice: Batting Practice](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565499-19.jpg)

modules.title: Practice: Training and Workouts
modules.content:
Training/Workout is a new practice workflow, that allows you a simple way to import video files without logging data.

This is a tool to catalog video files, such as large scale defensive practice, side angle video, scouting video of a potential recruit, etc, to be easily accessed and viewed in the Synergy Softball app. This allows you to organize video files, with ability to group selected clips, assign players to groups, and assign predefined and/or custom labels to groups of video files.

### Getting Started

To get started, select the **Practice** tab. This will display a list of all of your practice sessions. To create a new Training/Workout, select **Add Practice**, and select **Training/Workout** from the dropdown menu.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-01.jpg)

Begin by selecting the **League**, **Date**, **Team** you would like the for your files, then click **Apply**.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-02.jpg)

Next, select the **Add Video File(s)** button, and select the video files you would like to add from your device. The selected video files will then be displayed in a list below with all of the video files information.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-03.jpg)

You can preview any file by clicking the play icon in it's row, and it will display on the video player in the left panel. The video player has buttons to jump forward or backwards by one frame (1f), five seconds (5s), or thirty seconds (30s). You can also turn audio on or off using the speaker icon, enter fullscreen, or pop out the video player to it's own window using the undock button.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-04.jpg)

To the right of the +30s button, the **>>** button allows you to skip to the next video file on the list. You can use this to scan through your video files to determine which files you would like to group together. For example, if you have added 17 video files, and the first 6 files are scouting video of one player, you may want to group those files together.

### Grouping Files

To group video files together, select the desired files you would like to group by clicking the radio button to the left of the File Name, ensuring the blue dot is displayed for all the files you would like to group. Once the files are selected, click the **Group Selected Clip(s)** button above the table, then select **New Group** from the dropdown menu.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-05.jpg)

The new group will be created, displaying a list of the files selected below the original list, with a tab labeled **Group 1**.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-06.jpg)

You can now repeat the process with any remaining video files in the list above, creating as many groups as you desire. As you continue to group your files into new groups, if you come across a file that should have been added to a previous group, simply select the file, click the **Group Selected Clip(s)** button, and then select the group you would like to add it to from the dropdown menu.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-07.jpg)

You have the ability to add more video files to this group from you device by selecting the **Add Video File(s)** button within the group tab. You can also remove a file from the group by selecting the radio button for the unwanted file, then clicking the **Ungroup Selected Clip(s)**button. This will remove the file(s) from the group, and put it back with the ungrouped files listed above. If a grouped clip is in the wrong group, you can select the file, then click **Move Selected Clip(s)** button, and select the correct group, or create a new group from the dropdown menu.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-08.jpg)

You can also rearrange the order of the clips within a group by hovering over the file, clicking and dragging the six dot icon on the very left of row, next to the radio button.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-09.jpg)

> NOTE: The order of the files at this stage, is the order they will be arranged for viewing in the Practice tab in the Baseball App.

###

### Adding Identifying Information

### Add Players

By clicking the **Add Players** button, the roster for the team you have selected in the left panel will display, and by checking the box next to their name(s), those players will now be associated with those video files. If the player you want to add is not on the displayed roster, you can use the Player Search field to add them to the team, and then select them from the list below.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-10.jpg)

###

### Add Labels

By clicking the Add Label(s) button, you can add a whole host of Synergy created tag information that will be associated with your group of clips. The categories include Pitching, Hitting, Fielding, Baserunning, Catching, as well as Custom Labels.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-11.jpg)

Custom labels are shared across your organization, meaning not only the custom labels you have created in the past, but any custom labels created by other users on you staff, will be listed below. You can create new custom labels by entering them in the field at the top of the labels menu, and clicking **Add**. Existing labels can be edited by selecting the pencil icon next to it, or deleted by clicking the **X** next to it.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-12.jpg)

###

Once you've added all of the players and labels you would like to identify the files in your group, they will be displayed in the fields at the bottom. If you would like to remove a player or label, you can simply click the grey X next to the unwanted information.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-13.jpg)

### Uploading

Now that your group has all your files, player and label information you want, select the files by clicking the radio button at the top of the list, ensuring the files in your group are selected with a blue dot. At the top of the page, click the **Start** button to begin the encode and upload of the video group.

You will see the progress displayed in the Encode and Upload columns within your group. Once the files have been successfully uploaded, a green checkmark will be displayed in the Upload column to the right. Repeat the process with all remaining groups.

![Screenshot: Practice: Training/Workout](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565501-14.jpg)

modules.title: Transferring, Syncing and Sharing
modules.content:
## Transfer View

**

The Transfer View is used to monitor encodes and uploads that are associated with a game that is going to be logged or is already logged.

In order to get started, click on the **Transfer View** in the upper right-hand portion of the screen.  Once clicked, the below view will appear on your screen.

![Screenshot: Transfer View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565491-01.jpg)

This screen will show any games that you are currently uploading or downloading as well as the following information that is associated with the video: League, Date, Name of File, Logging Status, Video Type, Encoding Progress, and Upload Progress.

In order to monitor videos that are being uploaded or downloaded, click on the **...** button that you see in the upper right of the screen.  Once clicked, the below screen will appear.

![Screenshot: Transfer View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565491-02.jpg)

Use the **In Progress** and C**ompleted** tabs to monitor videos that are currently uploading or downloading or have been completed.

## Sync View

Sync view is the bridge between imported video and your logged events, where you can match the two together to create a complete picture.

To get started, click on the **Sync** button in the View menu in the upper right. In the Camera Angle Configuration panel set the configuration for each uploaded angle. Choose the placement by selecting Left or Right for each angle.

Start synching by clicking **Create New Sync Point**. Change the sync point by clicking **Modify Sync Point** or remove it by clicking **Remove Sync Point**.

To scroll back and forth between sync points use **Previous Sync Point** and **Next Sync Point**. There are some basic controls located below the playback window. Available options include:

- **Video Navigation**: Use the slider to scroll forwards or backward.
- **Volume**: Use to jump ahead or back in the specific increments of time
- **Play/Pause**

To choose which camera angle and/or video you'd like to display, choose from the options to the right of the display panel.

Below the video panel is the timeline for each angle. The timeline includes a rectangular bar that represents how long each video file is for the respective angle. Click and hold each bar to move the video back and forth to sync up the appropriate moments in the timeline.

To undo, or redo, the last change that you made, click the **Undo** or **Redo** buttons located at the bottom of the screen.

When the video is ready to be saved, click **Apply**.

**
![Screenshot: Sync View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565494-01.jpg)**

When in the **Event Sync** view, you have the option of viewing a playlist that will show a list of individual pitches. This playlist is located to the right of the video display and includes an option to view by chronological list or by individual pitch. In addition to pitch and pitcher information, the individual pitch option showcases pitch location as well.

**Chronological Pitch Playlist View**

![Screenshot: Sync View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565494-02.jpg)

**Individual Pitch Playlist View**

![Screenshot: Sync View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565494-03.jpg)

## Sharing Games

The Shared Game workflow gives you the ability to easily share your logged games and practices with other Synergy Team Logger users outside of your organization.

Synergy recommends, that you complete all event logging, and importing of video, before beginning the Share process, as any changes made after the fact will not be represented in the Shared game without re-sharing the updated game.

#### Sharing a Game

In order to share a game or practice, it must have logged events, with video attached. In the Game view, select the game you would like to share, and click the **Share to Synergy Cloud** arrow in the Shared column.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-01.jpg)

> Note: The arrow will appear grey in the Share column if both requirements are not met. Once your logged events have video uploaded, the arrow will turn Black, and the game can be shared.

The Share panel will open with four fields. In the middle field named **Share With**, is a list of available leagues and teams that you can select to share your game with. You can either select an entire league, single team, or create a custom group of teams to share with.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-02.jpg)

You can use the Triangle button to the left of each league to expand your list to reveal conferences, divisions, and teams.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-03.jpg)

You can also use the search bar in the upper right to find the team you wish to share with.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-04.jpg)

In the upper left of the window is a list of your Groups. These groups can be created and customized for easy selection in future uses.

To create a New Group, select the desired recipients from the list of teams. Your selections will be listed in the bottom right panel. The selections list can be sorted by Leagues, Conferences, Divisions, and Teams, by using the associated tabs.

Once your selections have been made, name your group in the upper right field, and click the **+** icon next to it. Existing groups can be edited by clicking the pencil icon, or deleted by clicking the **X**.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-05.jpg)

The field in the upper right lists the available camera angles. You can choose to select which angles to share, or select **All Camera Angles**.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-06.jpg)

Once all of your selections have been made, click **Apply** at the bottom of the screen.

You will be returned to the Games page, and a Green Checkmark will be displayed in the Share column to reflect that the game has been shared.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-07.jpg)

####

#### Retrieving a Shared Game

To retrieve a game that has been shared with you, click the **Shared** view at the top of the page. This will pull up a list of all Games, and Practices that have been shared with your team.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-08.jpg)

In order to view shared games, you must copy the game to your database. In the Shared column, there will be a black Copy Icon displayed, indicating the game has yet to be copied.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-09.jpg)

Click the **Copy** icon, then click **Yes** to copy the game. Once copied, the icon in the Share column will change to Green, indicating that the game has been successfully copied.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-10.jpg)

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-11.jpg)

Now that the game has been copied, it will be listed on the Games page for future use. Copies will be identified by the green copy icon in the Shared column. Additionally, while hovering over the copy icon, the sender of the shared game will be displayed.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-12.jpg)

This copy is now yours, and independent from the original file. You can make changes and additions as you see fit, and they will not be reflected on the original users game file.

> NOTE: Receiving users are not able to share games that have been shared with them with third parties. Only the original creators of the game are able to share with other users.

#### Viewing Shared Games

Select the game, and click the Log Tab at the top of the page to view all of the logged events for the game just as you normally would with a game you created.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-13.jpg)

Shared games are also viewable in the Synergy Baseball Client App. Simply switch your data source to **My Team (All)**, and all shared, and created games and practices from the Team Logger, will be displayed.

![Screenshot: Sharing Games](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000572454-14.jpg)

If the sender of the game, deletes their original game file, the copy you have created will still be viewable as long as you've made your copy before the original is removed.

You may add additional data or camera angles to a game that has been shared, but in order for the camera angles to be viewable by the recipient, you must repeat the share process, and select all camera angles you would like to share.

If additional events or camera angles are added to the game, after your copy has been made, in order to view them you must delete your first copy of the game, then copy the new version to your database.

modules.title: Working Offline
modules.content:
## Offline Sync at Start Up

If you are working in the Logger while offline, if it is set to sync upon the next time it's connected to the internet, often it will cause a delay in the operating speed of the logger as it is trying to sync all of the new information into the system.  If you'd prefer not to have this occur, customize that in the Offline Sync at Startup options in Settings.

To get started, navigate to the hamburger menu in the upper right of the screen.  A drop-down will appear, click Settings.

![Screenshot: Offline Sync at Start Up](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565503-01.jpg)

In the General tab in Settings, you'll have two options: **Offline Sync at Startup** and O**ffline Sync: Include Completed Games.**

![Screenshot: Offline Sync at Start Up](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565503-02.jpg)

When the **Yes** radio button is chosen in **Offline Sync at Startup**, the Logger will sync all new input data while the Logger was offline.  When No is chosen, the Logger will not do so and you will have to sync it manually.

When the **Yes** radio button is chosen in **Offline Sync at Startup - Include Completed Games**, the Logger will sync any new data you've input while offline and sync any new game information from any completed games in your games list.

Once you've set your synching preferences, click **Apply.**

## Downloading Games for Offline Mode

The Synergy Logger allows you to work offline when logging a game.  When connected to wifi, or other connections such as Ethernet, any work done in the logger will save to the Synergy Cloud.  If you are working without wifi, or other connections, utilize the offline feature to log a game. Once a stable connection is again available, the logged data will be uploaded to the Synergy cloud.

To get started, navigate to the **Games**view, which is the default screen once the logger is opened. If you are working in another view, navigate back to the **Games** view to begin this process.

Using the filters in this view, search for the game you wish to work on if it is not immediately visible in the list of games. Once you've located the game you'd like to download for offline use, click on **Edit Game** to the right, above the games list.

In the **Edit Game** window, you can make adjustments to the game details if you wish, then select the **Send to Offline** radio button located in the lower right.

![Screenshot: Downloading Games for Offline Mode](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565505-01.jpg)

Click **Apply** to complete the action.  Once the game has been sent offline, it will appear in the Games View list with a green checkmark in the offline column.

Alternatively, if the game is saved to the Synergy Cloud without checking the **Send to Offline** radio button, you can click on the cloud icon in the offline column of the **Games**view to download the game for offline use.

![Screenshot: Downloading Games for Offline Mode](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565505-02.jpg)

## Uploading or Downloading a Game

Logged games require files to be associated with them to allow the stats to be synced with the appropriate moments in each game.

### How to Upload A Game

To upload a game, navigate to the Import view in the upper right of the screen.

To start an upload, click**Add Video Files** and browse to the file that you would like to upload.  Once the file has been selected, it will appear in the upload queue.  Monitor the status of the upload or import, and its details, using the fields in the queue.

To ensure that files are uploaded to the Synergy Cloud, click on the **Upload All Video** to Synergy Cloud radio button in the upper right.  If you do not want the video uploaded to the cloud, deselect this option.

As a secondary option, upload a game using the **Transfer** view. Select **Transfer** from the view menu in the upper right.

![Screenshot: Uploading or Downloading a Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565507-01.jpg)

Next, click the **ellipse** icon (...) to continue. This will open the **Transfer** view window, which displays a list of your uploads and downloads along with their associated progress data. Click the **ellipse** icon again and continue with the process.

![Screenshot: Uploading or Downloading a Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565507-02.jpg)

![Screenshot: Uploading or Downloading a Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565507-03.jpg)

This will open a drop-down menu. From here choose to:

- **Start Upload** - begin an upload
- **Pause Upload** - pause active upload
- **View Video Files** - allows you to see which video files are in the process of being uploaded or have completed an upload
- **Remove from List** - remove video from the queue.
- **Cancel Upload** - cancel planned upload
- **Delete Upload** - delete the chosen file from the upload queue.

![Screenshot: Uploading or Downloading a Game](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565507-04.jpg)

###

### How to Download a Game

Downloading a game works the same way, but instead of choosing a file to upload, you will select a game/video to download to your local machine.
